description: This file defines the React component 'ReportView' and related components for rendering a test report UI. It includes logic for filtering, navigation, and displaying test file and test case details in a web-based report interface.

classes.name: TestModelSummary
classes.description: A data structure holding summaries of test files and test cases for display in the report.

classes.name: TestCaseViewLoader
classes.description: React component for asynchronously loading and displaying a specific test case.

methods.name: computeStats
methods.description: Calculates total count and duration of tests matching the filter within provided files.

methods.name: createFilesModel
methods.description: Generates a model of files and tests filtered according to the specified filter.

methods.name: createMergedFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a grouped model of test files when merging is enabled, aggregating tests by describe blocks.

methods.name: createSpeedboardFilesModel
methods.description: Prepares a model focused on test durations for speed analysis, sorting tests by duration.
